Agent Name: Data_Retrieval_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Attempted to run scraping code using an undefined function (scrape_wikipedia_tables) without importing it, causing the initial data retrieval to fail. This disrupted the workflow for obtaining the correct Wikipedia population data (as of end of 2018), leading to subsequent steps operating without validated, structured data and ultimately contributing to an incorrect population comparison and difference calculation.
